facts.F22: Claim-to-checker: Quint covers the pure partition and type-toggle state model (docs/feature/story-6502-hide-outliers/model/outliers.qnt: partition of visible items, cut stable under toggles, chip count, all-types-hidden); TLA+ and Agda not needed (no concurrency, no proof obligation beyond finite sets). Broad numeric laws (median convention, boundary equality, monotone axis, line split) are checked by fast-check at the pure-module seam, numRuns 100, because Quint int sets do not cover arbitrary arrays. Liveness: not applicable, render-time pure derivation and one boolean open flag, no eventual-progress claim.
facts.F23: Type strength: native TypeScript only (repository checker is tsc -b with Biome). Outlier partition is returned as a record {drawn, outliers, median, cut} so a caller cannot take the cut without the median; OutlierChip props make rows, wording and the three effect ports (onOpenInList, onClose, usage callback) explicit. Representable invalid states left to runtime: negative or NaN Cycle Time (backend never emits; findOutliers treats the empty set as no median and returns no outliers).
facts.F24: Paradigm object_oriented project, functional-leaning React; no anemic-entity concern since no domain entity is added: the new rule is a cohesive pure module (outliers.ts) owning the median, cut and partition decisions, and the chart component owns only view state. nw-code-design-oo smell classes apply only to the chart component (keep it free of the median and cut decision).
facts.F25: Test substrate: Vitest + React Testing Library with the existing MUI mocks; one oracle file per slice under Lighthouse.Frontend/src/components/Common/Charts; command is pnpm --dir Lighthouse.Frontend exec vitest run <oracle path relative to Lighthouse.Frontend>. Per-test default budget applies, no derogation requested. No nWave scenario tags in code. The backend demo row (TZ-301) and enum member are pinned by existing backend test conventions at the application-service port, owned by the crafter and acceptance designer of slice 1; E2E page object for CycleTimeScatterPlotChart is extended with chip and popover and waits for data-widget-status=ready.
facts.F26: Input bounds: Cycle Time is a whole number of days >= 1 (inclusive calendar days); closed Work Item count N is unbounded (0, 1 and 2 items give a median but, for 1 item, the item cannot exceed 5 times itself so no outlier). Multiple 5 and the exclusive comparison (value > 5 x median; value == cut is drawn) are fixed, not configurable. Popover list capped at 10 rows, longest first, remainder reachable via Open in a list. No bound on outlier count.
